verdict: INVALID — degenerate trajectory, not a gate result
cause: The system prompt asked for a command "the way you would speak it aloud", which elicits natural prose ("Pick up the kettle from the ground"). The TextWorld parser wants terse verb-noun ("take kettle"). Nothing in the loop taught the agent the difference, so it never left the starting room.
fix: Few-shot exemplars demonstrating terse commands, using invented rooms and objects so no world content leaks. Same approach A4 validated. Plus an early-abort guard on parser-rejection rate.
